W: Soft stone? No. Stone draped in blankets. Somebody wanted even the walls to be comfortable.
B: The open-hand banner, used as a blanket.
S: A vast sofa, deep purple, heaped with cushions and medals.
K: The great door, back to the lower barracks.
3: A hole behind the sofa, torn through the wall. Daylight, very far up.

objects.name: Baron Plush
lines: Oh… a visitor. Don't get up, dear. Nobody's getting up. That's the lovely part.
Boys? Tuck our guest in, would you. Gently.
There you are, dear. Still awake? Remarkable.
The hole behind my sofa goes up and out. Mind the drop. I'll be along, eventually. Probably.
